intro: AccountDumpling, APT41, and Bluekit were the most active threat actors in credential-theft incidents between 12 April and 4 May 2026, according to 29 reports. The campaign featured the exploitation of CVE-2026-33829 and affected the technology, software development, cloud services, financial services, and social media sectors. Targets spanned Global, Europe, North America, Bangladesh, and South Asia. The severity mix included 21 high, six critical, one medium, and one informational alert.
